posts.text:
A quarter century after we all pledged to “Never Forget,” we’ve forgotten. 
Here we are. More divided than ever. Awash in partisanship and pettiness. An empire in radical decline. Isolated from our allies. Entangled in another endless war in the Mideast.

charliesykes.substack.com/p/what-happe...

The lies, the disrespect, the bogus claims, may seem same-old-same-old after 10 years of Trump’s assault on truth and decency.

But we should not sleep on the stolen valor of the man entrusted with the fate of the nation.
